title: Networking Block
description: Enable multiplayer functionality with voice chat and custom avatar support.

signalingurl.description: P2PCF signaling worker origin used to broker WebRTC connections

roomslug.description: Room identifier; peers sharing a slug join the same session (defaults to a slug derived from the world)

participantlimit.description: Maximum number of concurrent users allowed in the room

customavatars.description: Allow (1) or disallow (0) custom avatar URLs from users

voicechatenabled.description: Enable (1) or disable (0) voice chat functionality
